quest.title: The Surprise That Awaits Us All!
quest.description: The Easybreeze Album is filled with the happy memories of your time spent with everyone. At last, the time has come for prizes to be presented...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Unknown Item #364519 x1, Easybreeze Badge x1, Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Unknown Item #364520 x1, Easybreeze Badge x1

chapter.title: The Surprise That Awaits Us All!

talks.objective: Wait until morning the next day (08:00 – 12:00)
Wait until morning the next day (08:00 – 12:00)
Head to the reception to redeem your rewards

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you guys! Good morning! How's everything been these past few days?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fantastic! Awesome food, nonstop fun... Living the carefree vacation life has been pretty great!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Did anyone just hear that voice on the wind?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Huh? A voice? I didn't hear anything...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Seriously? Listen, there it is again! "Venti, Venti..." It's the Aphimead calling my name!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh*... C'mon, Venti. At least save the drinking talk until an appropriate drinking hour, will you...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Think of it this way — your bard friend could be in a bar somewhere right now. But, instead, he chose to be here with you. Says a lot, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well, well, you really do have the eyes of a hawk. Just like a qucusaur, indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Hehehe, looks like the Asha's in a good mood too.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wanna tell the others about our little friendly competition just now?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Haha, what's with that reaction? Now I'm intrigued!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Well, I was just getting ready to head out when the Asha started bouncing around the room, full of energy, and kept showing off his badge.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: "Alright then, let's have a little contest. How do you wanna do this?" I said.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The last thing I expected was for him to stretch out his little hand... and challenge me to an arm wrestling contest!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Paimon's guessing you won?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah, it was no contest. The size advantage was really unfair. I feel kinda guilty, honestly...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So, I was thinking... how about a graffiti contest instead! We can do it in a little bit. I've got the paint covered...

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Well, sounds like the fun isn't over yet! I'm glad to hear it's been a good stay so far.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: So, the main challenges in the four areas... I'm guessing you've completed them all?

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Great! Let me take a look...

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hm? Something wrong?

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: This is... some kind of joke, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaaaah!!!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Geez, Paimon! Why'd you scream like that? Scared the life outta me... What's going on?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry... Paimon's definitely a scaredy-cat, but this time it's deserved...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: What in the...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Huh? ...How on earth did the photos turn out like that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? It's like a whole different bunch of people...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Just calm down for a second, and take a closer look — the clothes, the poses... it really is us.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Then what's going on here?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Did someone paint over it? But... there's no trace of anything like that. The photo looks like this is exactly what the Kamera captured, but that doesn't make any sense...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: What about the others?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me see...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: All four photos have changed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, you guys have fun with that... Paimon's just gonna float over here and try not to think about how creepy this is...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Could it be some kind of prank?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Is that the last one?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Turn the page again...)

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: You'll have to excuse us, sir. We'll come back another time for the prizes.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Come on, let's talk over there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... Notice anything useful?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I can't make out the faces, but the outfits are unmistakable! They've gotta be from the People of the Springs, the Flower-Feather Clan, the Collective of Plenty, and the Masters of the Night-Wind...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: The Tecpatl's Flintblades Adventure Team...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: It's the Tecpatl's Flintblades Adventure Team... We read about them back in Villa Guiztli, remember?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: A group of friends from different tribes, united by a single goal — to make the name of their Adventure Team, the Tecpatl's Flintblades, known throughout all of Teyvat.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But, then a couple in the group had a baby, and decided it was time to move on. So, they planned one final journey as a farewell to a life of adventuring...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Mind if I take another look?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Here.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I knew I'd seen that place before. It's right here.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: What do you mean? How's that even possible?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Bennett said the events described in those notes took place a long time ago. There wasn't even a resort here back then!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Doesn't mean it's not the same place. Just look at the terrain.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hmm... Well, that place doesn't look at all familiar to me...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I've flown past that area every day on my morning loop. I can show you exactly where it is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, should we go take a look?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah. Let's go...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Now, hold on just a minute... Why don't we think this through one last time before we head out?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Mmm... Prank or not, the person who left these pictures must be trying to tell us something.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: If this clue is pointing to a specific location, the only way to find out more is to go there ourselves, that's what I think.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: That's a fair point.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But, we also need to consider that Chasca never noticed anything odd while out on patrol. And, presumably, someone managed to slip these photos into our album without alerting a single one of us...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: So, we shouldn't underestimate who we're dealing with here... Is that what you're trying to say?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Pretty much.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, we keep our guard up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bennett?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: The place we're heading to might be dangerous. Could you keep an eye on our Asha friend while we're gone?

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I... I saw him head in that direction already... I thought, maybe, you told him to go there? He left just now, while you were talking...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh oh...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: It's okay. We're headed there, anyway.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Let's try to catch up with him. Keep an eye out on the way!

talks.objective: Go to the place indicated in the photograph

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Well, here we are. This is the place.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's so quiet... If someone lured us here, there's no sign of them...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Let's split up and have a look around. Don't go too far, though... and keep an eye out for any signs of the Asha.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like there's anything here...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Asha! Come out, come out wherever you are!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Was that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guys, get over here!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I hear something... A voice keeps calling out to me.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What did I tell you? The Aphimead, it speaks to people!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: No, it's not the mead... But, it is calling my name, and asking me to walk towards...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe it's a Domain entrance, but...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: What's that doing here...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The voice... it's coming from inside.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Careful. What if it's a trap?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: No... It's not a trap.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The tone of the voice... There's no trace of malice, only care and concern...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett, you're not thinking about going in there, are you? Uh, Tone-Deaf Bard, talk some sense into him!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I know you're all worried about me, and I'm aware there could be danger ahead...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But I have this strange feeling like... The things I've been searching for, the voice calling my name, the mystery behind those pictures... The answers are here, inside this place.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: My dads always tell me adventurers never shy away from a challenge or a chance to explore the unknown...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So, I need to go into this Domain, but I don't expect anyone to follow me... The last thing I want is to put you all in danger too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What now?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: "Adventure is all about teamwork." You said that yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Yeah, I mean {NICKNAME} and Venti go without saying, but we're part of the team too at this point, right? We're not gonna let our captain go in alone!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You guys...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, Paimon was going to try and talk you out of it... but she knows how hard it is to convince an adventurer not to go adventuring.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, if there's treasure at the end of this adventure, we're getting a share too — don't even think about hogging it all yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Well? What do you say, Professor?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Come on, you really think Professor Venti would abandon a student in their hour of need?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Save the thank-yous for the afterparty. Looks like someone else'll be picking up the tab again — lucky me, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, sure... Thanks, guys, it means a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Alright then, is everyone ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What... is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's so hot... Feels like my lungs are being compressed... Whew, it's hard to breathe...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Be careful. I sense the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Abyss!?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Ugh, the air currents are all over the place. I can't get a fix on its exact location.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could the Abyss be after Bennett? Wait a sec... Where's he gone?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Bennett!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett! Are you there?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: How did we get separated? We all came in together, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not good...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (The scene transitions)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (Where is this place? It feels like I've been here before...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (Why does it seem so familiar...?)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}... Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Ugh... *cough* *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (My throat... Ugh, it hurts...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Anyone there...?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (Still no response, and no sign of anyone... Am I the only one who got separated from the others? Or did we all get split up?)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (No, no...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (My heart's beating faster and faster, my back is drenched in cold sweat... and I can't remember anything... At this rate, I could pass out at any moment...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (Feel like I need a moment to catch my breath...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (I can't figure out if this counts as good or bad luck.)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (If I've ended up in a dangerous situation like this, even on my lucky streak, the others are probably in even greater danger...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (I need to help them... I have to keep moving...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (Come on, this pain is nothing... Just gotta keep pushing forward... I can do it...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: (I'm fine, absolutely fine... Everything is gonna be fine... I just need to find the others...)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wait... for me...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (The scene transitions)

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Um, is it just me or did those weird stars just get darker? I've got a bad feeling about this...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: We can't just wait here. We have to keep looking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, things are bad if Tone-Deaf Bard's getting serious...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Again!? Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's stomach hurts... Feels like she's gonna puke...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It's getting more and more dangerous the further we go...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard, are you sure Bennett is up ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Fate has drawn him back to this place. It is a trial he must overcome... But if he tries to go it alone...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hang in there, everyone! We need to pick up the pace.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon... can't go any further...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Now, everyone, now!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (Use QTE)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You're saying... this place is my final destination?

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Yes... Precisely...

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: "Lucky" little Bennett, the boy who cheated death itself...

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: You once slipped free from the grasp of fate and fled to a place beyond my reach... I imagine happiness came easy to you there...

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: It was sheer happenstance that allowed you to escape, but at last, fate has brought you back to face the death that should have been.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, that's what you think... But I believe we all have to take fate into our own hands.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Being an adventurer... means rewriting the rules... It means discovering... and challenging what seems impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: Ah, always the amusing bunch, you adventurers... So much passion, so much spirit, yet in the end, so little to show for it... just like your parents.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wh—What did you just say?

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: "Tecpatl's Flintblades"... What a laughable name. Hahaha... And ironic too, for the spark of their legacy dwindled long ago, and soon, I will snuff it out entirely.

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: Those who would have saved you are long gone. Behold, even your so-called "Wheel of Fate" lies in ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: Give up, Bennett... the child who cheated death...

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: Embrace your inescapable doom.

dialogues.speaker: Voice That Echoes
dialogues.text: You are no match for m{RUBY#[S]The Abyss}e.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I can't...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (The scene transitions)

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: That light... Is that...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The Asha! And look, one of them is Bennett's companion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett! Bennett! What's wrong? Please, Bennett, wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: This isn't working... His vitals are weak.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett! Come on, everyone, think of something!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Does anyone have any kindling on them?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...Kindling?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What he needs right now is light, something to guide him through this fiery trial of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Will a candle work?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Yes. Light it up, and the "sun" will guide him.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: You sure that's gonna work...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have faith in Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: ...Alright, then.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let us pray for him.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: As the sun sinks beneath the western shroud, let the sparks of flame guide us home.

dialogues.speaker: Everyone
dialogues.text: And a blazing light burn anew to cleanse impurities of old.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Lost wanderer, hear these words.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Behold the sunlight, this blade of dawn, listen to the wind sing a familiar song, inhale a fragrance so sweet, so known...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Follow me, please. Follow me home.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (Cut to 2D Package Video)

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Mom...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Is this a dream?

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: It's not a dream, my darling, not at all... Oh, look how much you've grown....

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: ...Dad, Mom! It's really you!

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Come here, my boy. Give your old man a hug...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... The air doesn't feel so heavy now. Paimon can finally breathe...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So, what we just saw was a...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: A memory left over from the past. Perhaps the Pyro Archon heard our prayers.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We owe her big time after this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that baby from Tecpatl's Flintblades turned out to be Bennett...

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: That's right. We strayed into this place all those years ago... and never made it out. All we could do was pour our dying hope into protecting this child... Our child.

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Isn't it my turn to give him a hug now, dear?

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Oh... alright then...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I know everything's been settled now, but this doesn't exactly strike me as the ideal place for a deep, meaningful conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Come on, everyone. Let's take this outside.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Alright, this should do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like there was a treasure at the end of all this, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean Bennett, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: "Bennett"... That's what your friends call you?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's the name my dads gave me. A group of older adventurers from Mondstadt raised me.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Bennett... Hmm, Bennett...

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: "Blessed," that's what it means. Having a name like that... It shows those people care about you a great deal.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: It's a fine name, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: I'm so happy for you, my darling Bennett. Seeing the strong young man you grew up to be, knowing you're surrounded by people who love you, it... It means the world.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Mom, I'm doing great. Everyone's always been so kind to me...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Be sure to thank them, son, on behalf of myself and the rest of Tecpatl's Flintblades. Haha, just look at us, together like this!

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: I've seen more than my share of miracles, it's true — but after what happened, I never thought I'd get a chance to talk to my son, let alone...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Ah!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: What is it, Dad?

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Our adventures together over the past few days... All the memories just came flooding back.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: And, speaking of... How could you call that arm wrestling this morning? That was full-on wrestling, my boy!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Uh... really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Bit of a tangent, but Paimon just realized... This means Bennett's from Natlan, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ohhh, and he's been disconnected from Natlan's Ley Lines all this time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Which must be why he's always been so unlucky... until he finally came back!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What are your thoughts about staying in Natlan, Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah... I could help introduce you to the Wayob! Would you rather go with the Masters of the Night-Wind or the Collective of Plenty?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: You don't have to answer that right away.

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, could I take a look at your album for a second?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, here you go.

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: ...Okay, all better now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aha, mystery solved! So the pictures were swapped, after all!

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: I should probably explain... After becoming Asha, we lost our memories, and our minds became so hazy we couldn't even remember who we were. All we had were our instincts to guide us...

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: But I was never as outgoing as Macani, and that was true even as an Asha. I guess some things, like your personality, never change...

response.speaker: Macani
response.text: So... Where's this going, exactly? Aroni, what have you been up to?

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: From the moment I saw your group, I've been following you around, taking all kinds of photos of your adventures.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: And since there are Asha everywhere in the resort... No wonder I didn't sense any danger.

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: A vague sense of familiarity, and a bunch of hazy memories... That was what drew me towards you.

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: When I followed you all here, it was like this place was beckoning me in, and it made me extremely uneasy...

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: Thanks to all of you, everything turned out fine. But the fact is, I put everyone in grave danger... and I'm so sorry for that.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Don't worry about it.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: After everything you went through, it wasn't your fault...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Exactly! The way I see it...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: If fate is a giant wheel rolling down the road, then I'd say, for Bennett, the bumpiest stretch is behind him. And that's all that really matters.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Thanks, everyone... And, um... Thanks, Mom and Dad...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I love you... So, so much...

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: I love you too, my darling son. And, here. This picture is for you.

response.speaker: Aroni
response.text: I've always loved taking pictures of you... And, nothing will ever change that.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Mom...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Child of reverie / Clutching tail feathers tight / Open not thine eyes ere night be gone."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "'Til such gaze, enduring and unspoken / Cascading from on high / Ushers in the break of dawn."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure pick your moments to shine, don't you...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Of course! I would hate for us to miss the next chapter of this story, after all. The wind is blowing it this way as we speak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And, by that, you mean...

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Whew... I found you, at last!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Someone actually showed up!? Quick, don't let them see...!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's up?

response.speaker: Rhythmos
response.text: Good heroes, sorry to interrupt! I'm just here to let you know that the grand opening of the resort is about to begin on Tete Isle. We're just waiting for you to join us, and then we can start the show!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Oh no, I totally spaced out! What time is it? Forget it... Let's just go!

choices.text: Maybe he'd rather return to Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #The Dance-Off Stage is all yours, {NICKNAME}. We'll go get into position.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The moment we've all been waiting for.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You've got it, guys! Professor Venti and I will be in the crowd cheering you on.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: We'll also be—

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Shhh!

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Ohhh...

talks.objective: Operate the Dance-Off Stage and complete the performance
Operate the Dance-Off Stage and complete the performance

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (Seamless Cut to the Package Video)

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Well, we don't get to be on a stage together very often. Why don't we take a group photo?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, yes! I'll get the Kamera set up!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wow, when did Mualani become such a natural photographer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's taken so many pictures on this trip, she's practically a professional at this point...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Come on, scoot in towards the middle, everyone — Asha friends, you too!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: ...Thanks, Pyro Archon!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Is Ajaw in another timeout?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Well, he's prone to unending rants whenever he's around Cacucu, and I think we can all agree the decibel level around here is high enough already.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Wait, where's Cacucu, then?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: He's still having fun on the Asha trampoline. I wouldn't be surprised if he's speaking Asha by the time we get back...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Another language under the belt? Little fella's turning into quite the polyglot.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: So, no flaming hair today, Archon?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hehe, isn't it hot enough already?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, hot as a volcano...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Enough with the chit-chat! Everyone looking this way? Ready for the countdown?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Party time!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (The scene transitions)

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: ...We always hoped you would have good friends around you, and it seems like that came true.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah... They're the best.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: You're not a picky eater, are you? And you don't stay up late every night, like your mom...?

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Uh... Alright, I'll stop with the nagging...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Dad...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: C'mere...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Can we... talk a little more?

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Listen up, son. And this is coming from one team leader to another...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: I know you're strong, and I know you're hardworking. But when it comes to leading a team, that alone's not gonna cut it.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Remember what I said to you earlier, when you were down in the dumps? "Every journey is a lesson. Never lose sight of the bigger picture."

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Your team is going to look to you for guidance one day. It'll be up to you to earn their dedication and trust, and offer them words of comfort during times of struggle.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Mm... I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: The name of our own Adventure Team, Tecpatl's Flintblades, embodies a particular idea — the striking of a spark, and the passing of the torch.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: But then we brought you into the world, a little spark of our own, and our thinking began to change.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: And we knew that what we wanted most of all... was not for you to be bound to our mission or legacy, but to forge your own path.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Dad...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: As a father, there are things I want to say to you, son. So, humor your old man for a bit, okay?... Heh, even though I'm not actually that old...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Son, your mom and I have loved you all your life, even since before you were born. And as you grew up, you had friends to offer you love and support where we couldn't...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Never forget them, and never forget your dads back in Mondstadt. It's thanks to them, after all, that you're blessed with such a lucky name.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: No matter where you go, or what path you choose, as your parents, we will always support you.

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: So all that's left to say is...

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Trust in yourself, and be brave, my boy. Just like your friend said, you are our "lucky star"... forever and always.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: *sobs*...

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Look what you've done, you've upset him again!

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: C'mon, that's not my f—

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Not your what?

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: N—Nothing... I'm just gonna... quit while I'm ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: *sobs* Yes, Mom?

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Don't listen to your old man's rambling. I was always the smart one, and he knows it too.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Mom...

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: ...It's scary business, having a child, you know that? But, the moment I laid eyes on you, I was at peace.

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: Because in your eyes, I saw your Dad's courage and my curiosity, and I knew you would be able to overcome any obstacle. So, don't cry, my son.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I—I'm not. I'm smiling... See? I'm smiling...

dialogues.speaker: Aroni
dialogues.text: I know you are... I've always known.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Is it time for you to leave already?

dialogues.speaker: Macani
dialogues.text: Haha... I've said all that needed to be said. Now, I can be at peace, too.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Trust me, Mom and Dad... Some day, I'm gonna be the most legendary adventurer in all of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bennett, are you okay?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I... I'm fine.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: They're finally at peace.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This wind is so strong... Paimon can barely stay in the air!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hang in there, Paimon. I've got your hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaaaaah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thought she was gonna get swept away there... Gah, this place is so creepy...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'll lead the way. Stay close, and whatever you do, don't fall behind.
